Right Hand of the CEO
positions.description:
SkyVisor enables companies within the renewable energy sector to fully capitalize on their renewable energy assets by digitalizing, standardizing and automating their assets' inspections and by giving their technicians the flexibility to independently inspect whenever, wherever, and as many times as they want. This objective is met by deploying fully automated drone-based inspections of wind turbines and solar panels, acquiring high-quality, standardized, and fully comprehensive data, and by enabling the companies to internalize SkyVisor's solution and perform the inspections themselves.
The SkyVisor applications are designed to be straightforward and easy-to-use, and additionally feature AI based data acquisition and processing in order to simplify and expedite the analysis of inspection results. Moreover, the SkyVisor team is always present to support and guide their clients every step along the way of internalizing and deploying their solution. Check out our website if you want to learn more about us: https://www.skyvisor.fr !

positions.description:
Im Rahmen des Praktikumsstipendiums "Globalisierte Arbeitswelt" des Lionsclubs durfte ich ein sechswöchiges Schülerpraktikum bei TE-Connectivity direkt nach meinem Abitur absolvieren. Die ersten zwei Wochen dieses Praktikums habe ich am Entwicklungsstandort in Bensheim erste Einblicke in das Unternehmen bekommen können. In den darauf folgenden vier Wochen in Évora, Portugal konnte ich meine Einblicke in die Produktionstechniken und deren Schnittstellen, wie Planung, Qualitätsmanagement und Customer Service weiter vertiefen und erste spannende Einblicke bezüglich kulturell bedingter Unterschiede des professionellen Arbeitslebens sammeln. 
Im Anschluss an das Praktikum durfte ich die Ergebnisse und Eindrücke, die ich im Verlaufe des Praktikums gesammelt habe, dem Präsidenten der TE Global Automotive Business Unit vorstellen.

company.description:
BEAT81 is the most interactive, intelligent and exciting group fitness experience on the market. Our mission is to help people Sweat Smarter Together! We do this by merging the best of mobile HIIT training, live heart rate monitoring and expert coaching & support. This allows us to create a truly unique experience that is perfect for anyone, from beginner exercisers to experienced athletes.

What's the BEAT81 difference?

EFFICIENCY: 45-minute, HIIT and Spinning workouts push you into your heart's optimal training zone, so you increase endurance, unlock the calorie afterburn and burn up to 1000 calories.

TECHNOLOGY: Heart rate monitors track your body's response to every squat, sit-up and sprint, so you can watch your performance live on our mobile BEAT81 TV's

ANALYTICS: In-depth, personalized training results are displayed in our App after each workout, allowing you to track your progress and strategically reach your goals

COMMUNITY: You're not alone. Our supportive, motivational, and fun community is with you every step of the way
